title: feat(spec): an AI blueprint field declares multiple, accept and maxSize
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Pm2baGwmMbgCeMb9cAzwSq)_
Fixes #34275

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches no blueprint field key; the blueprint guide the design model reads lives with the applier in cloud, and cloud#4400 carries it.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** AI 蓝图的字段(`apply_blueprint` 解析的宽松版与站内设计模型生成用的 strict 版)新增 `multiple`、`accept`、`maxSize` 三个键，取值形状照抄对象字段契约；`multiple: true` 只允许在对象字段本就允许的类型上，`radio` 照旧拒收，均按名拒在该键上。
- **为什么改:** 「报销单带多张电子发票」这类需求，AI 搭建时只能做出单文件字段或被整单拒收；cloud#4400 等这三个键落进 spec 才能把它们带进建好的字段。
- **风险与回滚:** 纯放宽，不写这三个键的蓝图解析结果与之前一字不差；对象字段契约只多导出一个现有函数 `multiDeclarableFieldTypes()`，行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。过渡期提醒：spec 发版后、cloud#4400 落地前，cloud 的映射器还不搬这三个键，多文件字段会被建成单文件(见 Acceptance notes)。
- **先看:** `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` 的 `refuseUndeclarableMultiple` 与 `refuseUnfitDefaultValue` 新增的多值 select 分支；`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` 的导出改名；`solution-blueprint.test.ts` 末尾新 describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`，预期 132/132 通过，其中「refuses `multiple: true` on exactly the types the built field refuses it on」逐个类型对照 FieldSchema。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`BlueprintFieldSchema` (lenient, what `apply_blueprint` parses) and `StrictField` (the strict mirror the in-app design model generates against) gain three keys the object field contract already declares, with `FieldSchema`'s own value shapes:

| key | lenient | strict | where it applies |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `multiple` | `z.boolean().optional()` (no `.default(false)`, so a field that omits it parses as before) | `.nullable()` | the declarable set: select / lookup / user / file / image, redundantly multiselect / checkboxes / tags |
| `accept` | `z.array(z.string()).optional()` | `.nullable()` | the media family (file / image / avatar / video / audio); not refused elsewhere, as on `FieldSchema` |
| `maxSize` | `z.number().int().positive().optional()` | `.nullable()` | the media family; not refused elsewhere, as on `FieldSchema` |

- **`multiple: true` refusal, by name at `['multiple']`.** `refuseUndeclarableMultiple` reads `FieldSchema`'s own declarable set. That set was module-private (`multiDeclarableTypeSet`); it is now exported as **`multiDeclarableFieldTypes()`** (renamed, body unchanged, still computed on first use for the TDZ reason in its docblock), so the type list is not copied. `radio` is in the set and refused by its own branch, as on `FieldSchema`. The message names the remedy types (the set minus `radio`). The two cross-key rules run in one refinement (`refineBlueprintField`), so the dropped-refinements ledger does not move.
- **A multi-value `select`'s options take no `kind` (review r1 M1).** `refuseKindOnMultiValueSelect`, `FieldSchema`'s rule in its wording: a lifecycle kind says where one record stands, and the field holds no single option code per record. One issue per option that declares a kind, at `options.N.kind`, the same paths `FieldSchema` refuses. `radio` with `multiple: true` is left to the `multiple` refusal; the `multiselect` / `checkboxes` / `tags` kind case is unchanged.
- **A multi-value `select` takes no blueprint `defaultValue`.** Without this branch the widening opened a hole: `{ type: 'select', multiple: true, defaultValue: 'open' }` would parse here (the literal check reads `{ type, options }`) and the built field would refuse it (it judges the default against the list contract). Refused by name at `['defaultValue']`; the `defaultValue` describe says so.
- **Describes.** Each names where the key applies and what it does on the built field. `accept` / `maxSize` say "Read only on the media family". None says the field "is built with" the key: each says "carried into the built field by the applier", the wording `defaultValue` uses (see Acceptance notes on the carrier).
- **Regenerated:** `api-surface/data.json` and `export-origins/data.json` (the new export), `authorable-surface/ai.json` (three `ai/BlueprintField:*` rows), `content/docs/references/ai/solution-blueprint.mdx`. `check:liveness` and `check:strictness-ledger` were already current.

### Proposed public name (seat's call)

`multiDeclarableFieldTypes()` (returns a read-only set of type names), recommended. Alternatives: keep the old internal name `multiDeclarableTypeSet` (zero rename, but it reads without "field" beside `MULTI_CAPABLE_TYPES` / `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES` in the `data` namespace); or a predicate `isMultiDeclarableFieldType(type)` (narrower, but the refusal message needs the list, so a second export would follow).

## Tests

`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.test.ts`, a new describe block for the three keys, 12 cases:

- key parity (both sides carry the three keys); VALUE parity with `FieldSchema`: each key's lenient and strict leaf accept exactly the battery values `FieldSchema.shape[key]` accepts (23 values), absent on the lenient side, null-not-absent on the strict side;
- CONTROL: a `file` field declaring none of them parses and gains no key (strict: three nulls);
- the e-invoice field `{ type: 'file', multiple: true, accept: [...], maxSize: 10485760 }` through both sides and into `FieldSchema`;
- `accept` / `maxSize` on file, lookup and select parse on both sides and on `FieldSchema`;
- `multiple: true` refused on `text` and on `radio`, one custom issue at the key, naming the field and (text) every remedy type;
- every `FieldType`: the blueprint refuses `multiple: true` at the key iff `FieldSchema` refuses it at `['multiple']`; `false` is never refused;
- a multi-value `select` with a default is refused at `defaultValue`, and `FieldSchema` refuses it too;
- a multi-value `select`'s kinded options are refused one by one at `options.N.kind`, at exactly the paths `FieldSchema` refuses (control: the same kinds on a single-value select, and a multi-value select without kinds, parse);
- an object whose `stageField` names a multi-value `select` is refused at `stageField` (control: the single-value select is not refused there);
- the describes name every member of `multiDeclarableFieldTypes()` and `FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`, and promise no build.

**Forced test edits:** every existing strict-mirror field fixture in the same file (10 fixtures) gains `multiple: null, accept: null, maxSize: null`, because strict mode requires every key; the `defaultValue` "refuses the key missing" fixture gains them too, so `defaultValue` stays its only missing key. No assertion changed.

Ablations (each committed, mutated through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty; the suite imports `src` directly):

1. `refuseUndeclarableMultiple(field, ctx);` replaced by a comment: 3 failed / 127 passed (the text, radio and every-type pins).
2. the multi-value select branch's `multiple === true` replaced by `false`: 1 failed / 129 passed (the multi-select default pin).
3. `refuseKindOnMultiValueSelect(field, ctx);` replaced by a comment (review r1): 1 failed / 131 passed (the kind pin).

## Acceptance notes

- **Carrier (card step 4).** Nothing in this repository turns a blueprint field into an object field. `git grep` for `SolutionBlueprint` / `BlueprintField` / `apply_blueprint` outside `packages/spec`: `packages/lint` reads the schema shape in one test, `packages/cli/src/lint/metadata-eval.ts` names the expansion as an injected seam in a comment, and `ui/packages/app-shell` replays proposals in chat history. So cloud's applier (cloud#4400) is the only carrier, and the describes say "carried into the built field by the applier", never "is built with". Whether `defaultValue`'s identical wording is true today is cloud's applier code, NOT MEASURED from this repository.
- **Transition window (carrier: cloud#4400).** cloud's undeclared-key refusal reads this schema's shape, so on the pin bump it admits the three keys at once; until cloud#4400 adds them to the applier's allow-list, a `multiple: true` file field would be built single-file with no feedback. cloud#4400 should take the pin bump and the allow-list together.
- `accept` / `maxSize` on a non-media type parse and are read by nothing, matching `FieldSchema` (card: follow `FieldSchema`).
- **Direct parse (review r1 S1).** At the `apply_blueprint` door the three keys were refused before, so nothing parses differently there. A direct `BlueprintFieldSchema.parse` used to strip them: `multiple: true` on `text`, `maxSize: 0`, or a multi-value select with a default parsed with the key dropped, and each is now refused at that key. The changeset states FROM and TO; the door-level `Clause-②: yes (widening)` stands.

## Verification

Review r1 (record 6907437381) was answered by one fix commit, a reference-page regeneration, and a merge of `origin/main` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (K was 17), with `authorable-surface/ai.json` regenerated from the merged tree. The PR's file list against `origin/main` is still the same 8 files. Head and gate readings are in the os-dev-report comments on #34275.
